title: Replicate What Varies: Resource Sharing for Domain-Randomized Embodied Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation provides a low-cost sandbox where embodied agents can attempt tasks, observe outcomes, and learn from experience. Running many diverse simulation environments concurrently can consume substantial CPU and GPU memory because independently constructed scenes duplicate resources that remain unchanged across instances. We present Patchwork, a resource-sharing system for domain-randomized simulation, built around the representation $E=T+\Delta$: a shared template contains common resources, and a patch records the mutations needed to construct a target environment. Patchwork separates randomization sampling from replay and selects reusable templates together with patches that preserve each target environment's intended configuration. Its layered runtime shares compiled model structure and immutable assets while keeping mutable parameters and simulation state private to each instance. translated_title: 复制变化之处：面向域随机化具身仿真的资源共享系统
translated_abstract: 仿真为具身智能体提供了一个低成本的沙盒，使其能够尝试任务、观察结果并从经验中学习。然而，同时运行多个多样化的仿真环境可能会消耗大量的CPU和GPU内存，因为独立构建的场景会重复复制那些在各实例之间保持不变的资源。我们提出了Patchwork，一个面向域随机化仿真的资源共享系统，其核心建立在表示 $E=T+\Delta$ 之上：共享模板包含公共资源，而补丁记录构造目标环境所需的变异。Patchwork将随机化采样与回放分离，并选择可复用的模板以及能够保持每个目标环境预期配置的补丁。其分层运行时共享编译后的模型结构和不可变资产，同时将可变参数和仿真状态保持为每个实例私有。我们在robosuite和MuJoCo上实现了Patchwork……
tldr: Patchwork提出“共享模板+差异补丁”（E=T+Δ）的表示方法，在域随机化具身仿真中共享各环境间不变的资源、仅复制变化的部分，从而大幅降低多环境并发仿真时的CPU和GPU内存开销。
en_tdlr: Patchwork introduces an E=T+Δ representation—a shared template plus per-environment patches—to share unchanged resources and replicate only what varies across domain-randomized embodied simulation environments, substantially reducing CPU and GPU memory consumption.
